name: Last Order
source:
The stage of this game is a family restaurant named flóreal. As an able floor manager, the protagonist enjoys the trust of his fellow staff members and respect of his superiors.

However, there was another side to this man. He gets closer to the female employees while feigning kindness… By the time he has attained their trust, he discovers and exploits their weaknesses, and forcefully makes them his own possession.

In reality, all of the women who work at this restaurant have already become his sex slaves. However, one day, two new job applications had come, and at that very moment, the protagonist had already decided on his next prey.

Although she seems to be a quiet, docile girl, in reality, she keeps hidden an unparalleled lewd side of hers. Not letting this go unseen, the protagonist comes up with numerous ploys in order to completely put his new prey to shame.

[From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
translation:
游戏舞台是一家名为flóreal的家庭餐厅。主人公是一名能力出众的楼面经理，深受同事信任和上司尊重。

然而，这个男人还有另一副面孔。他假装亲切地接近成年女员工…等到取得她们的信任，便找出并利用弱点，强行将她们占为己有。

实际上，餐厅里的所有成年女性都已成为他的性奴隶。一天，店里收到两份新的求职申请，而主人公就在那一刻选定了下一个猎物。

她看起来安静温顺，实际上却隐藏着无与伦比的淫荡一面。主人公没有放过这一点，设计出种种手段，企图彻底羞辱这个新猎物。

[摘自[url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
